content: Rnd1 is a small signaling G protein, approximately 21 kilodaltons in size, and functions as a GTPase. It belongs to the Rnd subgroup within the Rho family of GTPases. The RND1 gene encodes this protein. Rnd1 plays a role in modulating the organization of the actin cytoskeleton in response to extracellular growth factors, as demonstrated by Nobes et al. in 1998. Rnd1 has been identified to interact with several proteins, including GRB7, PLXNB1, PDE6D, ARHGAP5, and UBXD5.
